items.summary: Recommendation: approve a bounded preview-only build for howtofry.com, with production launch and monetization gated until the site-factory checklist is complete. Smallest next step: authorize the preview scope—cooking-product guides, recipes, visual system, and draft affiliate/social placements—without publishing or spending. Owner decision: approve this preview-only build gate for EXEC_CONV_12.
